research.title: A Simulation-Driven Digital Workflow Integrating Bayesian Optimization for Early-Stage Process Design: A Methyl Acetate Production Case Stud
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Methyl acetate production via direct carbonylation of dimethyl ether and carbon monoxide involves strong nonlinear interactions among reactor operation, recycle structure, and energy consumption, making conventional simulation-based optimization computationally demanding. In this work, a data-driven framework. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Mechanical properties of chiral helical polymers-from single filaments to actin bundles
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The mechanical properties of biological polymers are essential to their biological functions. Here, we introduce a highly coarse-grained model of helical filaments that preserves helicity and chirality while enabling mesoscale simulations. This is implemented in Cytosim. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: samQEq: universal charge equilibration for molecules and conductors
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge equilibration assigns atomic charges by equalizing an atomic chemical potential built from electronegativity, hardness and the Coulomb interaction. Under one global constraint it lets charge flow without limit between molecules, which fluctuating-charge models prevent with. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
